messages:
ana-peopleops: Hi @leo — quick check on your work authorization/renewal so we can lock the start date and benefits. Can you share the USCIS receipt number, biometrics date (if scheduled), and confirm passport expiry? Please upload scans to the secure folder. Thanks!
leo-newhire: Hey Ana — receipt MSC2401234567, biometrics set for 2025-06-12, passport expires 2027-09-03. I uploaded `leo_passport_scan.pdf` to the link and added a note.
maria-immigation: Thanks @leo. Can you also upload any EAD front/back or I-797 receipt copy (PDF)? If your EAD is still pending, we need the receipt + manager approval to allow provisional onboarding steps.
james-hrbp: Manager here — I approve provisional start (remote orientation + slack & email) if People Ops confirms access level. No production credentials until EAD/I-9 complete.
ana-peopleops: @james small typo — should be ana-peopleops. :slightly_smiling_face:
ana-peopleops: (resending) Noted. @leo if EAD arrives before 06/20 we can do full provisioning same day. If not, we can start limited access on 06/20 and update once docs arrive. Benefits enrollment window starts first day on payroll; enrolling remotely is fine.
leo-newhire: Got it. I also have an old EAD card photo — will upload front/back now. Filename format I used: `EAD_leo_front.jpg`, `EAD_leo_back.jpg`.
maria-immigation: Perfect. When you upload, add the USCIS receipt PDF and the biometrics notice screenshot. That helps our trackers.
onboarding-bot: reminder: I-9 eform pending for leo-newhire — please complete within 3 business days after doc upload: https://redwood.company/i9.
leo-newhire: Uploaded I-797_receipt.pdf and the biometrics notice. Let me know if anything else is needed.
ana-peopleops: Received. @james once payroll confirms provisional salary start date we will send benefits invite. Also will set a limited IAM role until EAD is verified.
james-hrbp: Confirmed provisional payroll start 2025-06-20. I'll flag with IT for limited IAM and escalate for faster provisioning if docs arrive sooner.
maria-immigation: FYI processing times vary; if biometrics goes smoothly we often see adjudication in ~90 days. Keep us posted.
leo-newhire: Thanks all — will update here if status changes. Appreciate the quick coordination. :thumbsup:
